# has sequence feature

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasSequenceFeature`](gmeow-hasSequenceFeature.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasSequenceFeature>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Links a biological sequence location to a feature annotation on that sequence. Non-functional: a single location may carry multiple features (overlapping genes, nested exons, multiple SNPs).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:BiologicalSequenceLocation`](../classes/gmeow-BiologicalSequenceLocation.md) -> [`gmeow:SequenceFeature`](../classes/gmeow-SequenceFeature.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasSequenceFeature`](gmeow-hasSequenceFeature.md) from [`gmeow:BiologicalSequenceLocation`](../classes/gmeow-BiologicalSequenceLocation.md) to [`gmeow:SequenceFeature`](../classes/gmeow-SequenceFeature.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:BiologicalSequenceLocation`](../classes/gmeow-BiologicalSequenceLocation.md), [`gmeow:SequenceFeature`](../classes/gmeow-SequenceFeature.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to link a biological sequence location to a feature annotation on it; non-functional, so overlapping/nested features coexist.

### Avoid when

- Avoid attaching coordinates here (they live on the feature's [`gmeow:hasSequenceCoordinates`](gmeow-hasSequenceCoordinates.md)).

### How to use

- Attach [`gmeow:SequenceFeature`](../classes/gmeow-SequenceFeature.md) instances via [`gmeow:hasSequenceFeature`](gmeow-hasSequenceFeature.md); each carries its own coordinates and type.

### Examples

- ex:chr7 [`gmeow:hasSequenceFeature`](gmeow-hasSequenceFeature.md) ex:brca1.
